title: Fast Forge
description:
Fast Forge is a lightweight Forge optimization modpack that boosts FPS, reduces lag, and speeds up loading times.
It includes carefully selected performance mods while keeping the vanilla Minecraft experience intact.
body:
FastForge

A lightweight performance-focused modpack built to make Minecraft run smoother without changing the vanilla experience.

This pack combines some of the best optimization mods available to improve FPS, reduce stuttering, speed up world loading, and make gameplay feel more responsive. Whether you're playing on a low-end laptop or just want higher framerates, FastForge is designed to get the most out of your hardware.

Features

- Higher FPS and smoother gameplay
- Faster chunk loading and world generation
- Reduced memory usage
- Better overall stability
- Vanilla-friendly experience
- Multiplayer compatible

Who is this pack for?

- Players with low-end or older hardware
- Anyone looking for better performance
- Players who prefer vanilla Minecraft with optimizations only

No unnecessary content mods, no gameplay changes — just Minecraft running the way it should.

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to leave feedback.
